name: c3-public-api
description: C3 Public API — single public-edge listener on oci-analytics. Consolidates http-to-smtp-proxy-api (Bearer-gated /mail/*) and c3-analytics-api passthrough (public /analytics/*). Replaces split listeners across gcp-proxy + oci-analytics so gcp-proxy becomes a pure wg0 spoke.
_domain_doc: PUB ROUTING (operator decision 2026-05-27): public-facing routes live under api.diegonmarcos.com/pub/* (high precedence, public ingress via oci-analytics). All other api.* paths remain wg-cloud-only (gcp-proxy edge over wg0). Renamed from /c3-public-api → /pub for clean separation of concerns.

host_sync._doc: #586 Vault files the ship copies to a host path OUTSIDE remote_path, for a bind mount compose.nix declares from this same entry (engine: cloud-infra cloud-ship-container-step-deploy-rsync.sh step_host_sync). Before this nothing put the profile bundle on oci-analytics: docker pre-created the mount source as an empty root-owned stub and Profile > Connect served an empty bundle dir since #566 while every ship went green. Only the listed files travel; the vault never lands on this public-edge VM. Missing source = the ship FAILS, never skips.

proxy._doc: Mixed-auth service. Default for base_path = Bearer-gated via introspect-proxy (same as c3-infra-api write routes). The /health, /ready, /analytics/* sub-paths are public — declared via the engine-supported public_paths[] array (9_others/src/engine/cloud-data-config-derive.ts:507 → caddyfile.nix:432 emits a pre-auth `handle <pp>` block per entry that strip_prefix base_path then reverse_proxy upstream).

mail._doc: JSON-in -> SMTP-out: replicates the aa-sui_tools-http-to-smtp-proxy-api Rust binary contract so the CF Worker does not need any change. Delivery to Maddy:25 (MX-style, plain SMTP over WG); Maddy's dual-write relays every local delivery to Stalwart:2025, so no shadow leg here (2026-08-18: shadow removed — it duplicated every message).

profile_connect._doc: Superapp Configs>Profile>Connect (#566). POST /profile/connect/start mails a one-time code to mail_to over the same maddy:25 delivery as /mail/http-to-smtp; POST /profile/connect/fetch {code} decrypts cloud-vault E0_configs/<bundle_file> at request time with the server's own age key and returns {schema, bundle}. Bearer (Caddy mkProtected + in-app X-Auth-User check) AND the mailed code are both required. Nothing here is a secret: the age key (a single AGE-SECRET-KEY-1 line) arrives from src/secrets.yaml under the name age_key_secret, through env_file .secrets (a non-agent service gets no /run/secrets mount, #359).
profile_connect._doc_bundle: The bundle dir on oci-analytics is deploy.host_sync.profile_bundle.host_dir (#586: cloud-vault E0_configs/, was configs/): the ONE declaration compose.nix mounts read-only at bundle_mount and the engine fills. bundle_file and schema_file name the files inside that mount; test-profile-connect.ts F5 pins that host_sync ships exactly them.
profile_connect._doc_sops: sops comes from the host's nix profile (oci-analytics system-packages declares sops+age), mounted the way c3-infra-api mounts it; the image stays node:22-bookworm-slim.

profile-connect.cmd: nix shell nixpkgs#sops nixpkgs#age --command node test-profile-connect.ts

limits._doc_request_timeout_ms: Caps nodemailer connectionTimeout + greetingTimeout + socketTimeout for the Maddy:25 delivery (warm completes <3s). 15000ms headroom retained from the removed Stalwart shadow leg (2026-08-18: shadow removed — Maddy's dual-write already relays every delivery to Stalwart:2025).

api.description: Single public-edge API on oci-analytics. /mail/http-to-smtp (Bearer) bridges CF Worker -> Maddy over WG (Maddy dual-writes to Stalwart). /analytics/{matomo|umami|openobserve}/* (public) passes through to first-party analytics backends.
